headline: Why do we still live apart?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 now run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS instead of certifying her. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every family ban below still stands; this family was NOT loosened.

🔴 NEVER SUPPLY A CAUSE for the separate homes — not that he is not serious, not that he is protecting himself, not money, not children, not an ex. The reason lives in him, and inventing one hands her something to act on. Its own test guard sweeps for exactly that. Never read the arrangement as a verdict on his feelings in either direction, never a timeframe, never an ultimatum, never tell her to move in or move out.

VOC (678 V1 concerns on the distance/living-apart theme) shows she has already HEARD the reasons — that is the point. "I've asked him to move in, but 'he can't right now financially.'" "He wants us to continue to grow together... how long should I wait?" "There is something not quite right with his home life but he doesn't discuss it with me." Every reason she has been given arrived without a date. So the read refuses the 'why' (his to give) and answers the shape instead: a plan and a habit look identical from outside, and nobody has told her which one she lives in. The absolution is the one she has never been offered — she has been doing the work of two people, living the arrangement AND translating it afterwards.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the wand in his hand is white at both ends.
You asked why you still live apart. Your hand went to the man who decides before he acts.
So the miles aren't the measure of him, dear. The card is clear with me there.
And nothing on that table got there by accident, dear. He set each thing down.
But a plan and a habit look the same from outside, dear.
That's why you've been guessing which one you live in, dear. Nobody has said.
Let me look closer at what sits between you and a plain reason…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the beam he hangs from is shaped like a T.
You asked why you still live apart. Your hand went to the card that turns a question over.
So he hasn't put you outside his life, dear. This card shows a man held, not gone.
And a man held in one spot can't come to you, dear. He can't leave either.
But you've had to work that out alone, dear. Every time, on your own.
That's why asking him got hard, dear. You'd already answered it for him.
Let me look closer at what stands between you and asking him…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — a red feather stands up from his cap.
You asked why you still live apart. Your hand went to the one who travels light.
So the quiet is what hurts, dear. Two front doors on their own wouldn't.
And look what he carries, dear. What fits on a stick, and no map.
But you can read a closed door for years and still be told nothing, dear.
That's why you're tired, dear. You've been living it and explaining it both.
Let me look closer at what has kept a plain reason from reaching you…
